items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 12 houses and 1 condos and townhomes listed in Lincoln Park. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Lincoln Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Lincoln Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 5 houses and 1 condos and townhomes sold in Lincoln Park over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Lincoln Park compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Lincoln Park held 7.8% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 0.4% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 92.3% of the 13 homes listed in Lincoln Park and condos and townhomes made up 7.7%; of the 2 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Lincoln Park than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 15 to 12 (−20.0%) and condos and townhomes fell from 2 to 1 (−50.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
